notes: yea and (t012-t013) is divided between גַּם and the waw, each morpheme holding the word written for it.
The resumptive אֹתָם is unrepresented beside the relative's whom, following rule 43's reading of אֲשֶׁר בּוֹ, where two morphemes point at the antecedent and the ASV writes one word.
מִפְּנֵי is split because the ASV writes from before, a word for each morpheme, which rule 30 names explicitly as the unmet-condition case.
